route-map rm-deny-first deny 5
 match ip address prefix-list PL-BLOCK
route-map rm-deny-first permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-ADVERTISE
!
route-map rm-clean deny 5
 match community 100
route-map rm-clean permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-ADVERTISE
 set metric 100
!
route-map rm-multi permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-A PL-B
!
route-map rm-two-stanzas permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-A
route-map rm-two-stanzas permit 20
 match ip address prefix-list PL-B
!
route-map rm-continue permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-A
 continue 20
route-map rm-continue permit 20
 set metric 50
!
route-map prepend-3 permit 10
 set as-path prepend 65010 65010 65010
!
route-map rm-in permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL-IN
!
end
